access_method: Official Steamworks User Reviews JSON endpoint for public app reviews only; Steam store and community HTML scraping are excluded.
authentication: The documented appreviews endpoint requires no user login or Steam Web API key; credentials, cookies, and authenticated account data are excluded.
rate_limit: Use bounded cursor pagination, one request at a time, conservative delays, request and elapsed-time budgets, and immediate termination on throttling or access denial; the reviews documentation publishes no endpoint-specific numeric quota.
allowed_usage: Internal source-quality and demand research on public review text only; no user contact, profiling, review solicitation, score manipulation, unsolicited marketing, or inference from private account data.
raw_text_retention: Normalized public review text is retained local-only for the experiment; raw SteamID values, profile data, play-history fields, credentials, cookies, developer responses, and full API payloads are not retained.
redistribution: Only derived aggregate metrics, source URLs, app identifiers, timestamps, recommendation and purchase-context flags, and non-reversible fingerprints may be shared; review text is not redistributed or used in marketing without reviewer permission.
deletion_handling: Remove locally retained text when a review disappears during a bounded refresh or upon a valid removal request; retain only non-reversible aggregate metrics when appropriate.
attribution: Every retained observation identifies Steam as the source and preserves the canonical app review URL and app identifier; no Valve or Steam endorsement is implied.
robots_or_automated_access_policy: Use only the programmatic User Reviews endpoint documented by Steamworks; do not scrape Steam HTML, bypass access controls, authenticate users, or continue after throttling or denial.
